restore_strategy: Copy the retained canonical file to a temporary sibling (never hardlink), verify its SHA-256 and byte count, restore recorded uid/gid/mode/atime/mtime, then atomically rename to duplicate_path. Do not overwrite an existing target.
target_rule: only exact-hash static polyMesh files in analysis/prep/attempt/reconstruction paths whose top-level bundle name is not dated 20261026; no 0-time fields or dictionaries
